title: HOW did a solid mountain temple defeat 3,000 soldiers ordered to destroy it? #Shorts
description:
HOW did a solid mountain temple defeat 3,000 soldiers ordered to destroy it?

In 1682, Emperor Aurangzeb deployed 1,000 to 3,000 troops with orders to completely demolish Kailasa. After three solid years of continuous attack, they could only chip external sculptures; the main structure remained completely unshakable, forcing them to abandon the campaign.

Produced by ARIA Sacred Heritage AI. Subscribe for the full 52-minute documentary.
